verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's own product page states that including a Jira issue key in commits automatically updates Jira issue statuses. It also offers a built-in Jira UI and lets users open Jira tickets from the PR screen, which covers commit-to-issue linking and status automation from commit messages. missing for 10: explicit documentation of linking pull requests (not just commits) to issues, detailed docs on commit-message syntax and status transitions beyond marketing copy, any independent or hands-on corroboration, and clarity that the capability depends on a connected Jira instance.
